citation_details.title: OcularLDT
citation_details.author: Teon L Brooks, Laura Gwilliams, Alexandre Gramfort, Alec Marantz
citation_details.abstract: OcularLDT is a neuroimaging dataset containing ocular measurements and magnetoencephalography (MEG) recordings during a lexical decision task. The dataset combines eye-tracking and MEG data to investigate the neural correlates of lexical processing and the relationship between oculomotor behavior and language comprehension. This is a NEMAR-hosted mirror of the original OpenNeuro dataset (ds002312).
